build_eic_client: build an EIC client from a YAML config file with remote URL and instance ID
test_set_tensors: test the EIC client mset method to store 16 bfloat16 tensors with a 3-second TTL
test_get_tensors: test the EIC client mget method to retrieve 16 bfloat16 tensors by key
test_exists_keys: test the EIC client mexist method to check existence of 16 keys
run_main_tests: run the main test suite initializing the client then testing set, exists, and get operations
